subject: DI04000241

h.en: 4.1.1 Drilling and boring:start with the hole condition

body.en:
Start with the situation

A solid plate needs a new hole; a cast housing already has a rough hole that needs true alignment. Those are not the same task.

Definition / principle

Drilling usually creates a hole with a rotating multi-edge drill; boring enlarges/trues an existing hole with a suitable boring tool.

Understand why

A cutting rotation plus axial feed produces material removal; holding must resist torque and thrust.

Application / illustration

Pillar drills serve smaller accessible jobs; radial machines position the tool over large jobs; borers address accurate existing holes.

Common mistake / conditions

A hand-held workpiece can spin violently if a drill grabs; secure positive workholding is essential.

Can a drill vice remain unsecured against rotation?

No. The complete workholding arrangement must resist cutting torque safely.
body.gu:
પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત

Solid plateમાં નવું hole જોઈએ;cast housingમાં rough holeને true alignment જોઈએ.બન્ને same કામ નથી.

Definition / Principle

Drilling સામાન્ય રીતે rotating multi-edge drillથી hole બનાવે;boring suitable toolથી existing hole enlarge/true કરે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Cutting rotation,axial feedથી removal થાય;holdingએ torque,thrust સહન કરવાં પડે.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

Pillar drill smaller accessible jobs;radial machine large job પર tool position કરે;borer accurate existing holes માટે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Drill grab થાય તો hand-held workpiece જોરથી ફરે;positive secure workholding જરૂરી છે.

Drill Vice Rotation સામે Unsecured રાખી શકાય?

ના.Complete holding arrangementએ cutting torque safely resist કરવું પડે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A column supports a spindle head and adjustable work table above a rigid base.

Construction:part and purpose

The base anchors the machine and supports large permitted work.

The column provides the main upright reference and support.

The head houses the motor and belt/gear speed transmission.

The spindle/quill carries the drill holder and provides axial travel.

The table supports a drill vice, clamps, fixture or permitted backing arrangement.

Feed controls and depth stop regulate approach and required hole depth.

Guarding, approved coolant/chip management and stop controls address cutting hazards.

Working:flow and reason

Identify hole location, size and required tolerance from the drawing.

Clamp and locate work with clearance for breakthrough where applicable.

Mount the approved drill/holder and select suitable speed/feed.

Motor transmission rotates the spindle and drill.

Axial feed advances lips into material while flutes provide chip space.

An approved depth/exit plan controls blind-hole bottom or breakthrough.

Stop safely before measuring, deburring or clearing chips with approved tools.

Common mistake / conditions

No gloves near rotating tools; never hold a job by hand or clear wrapped swarf from a rotating drill.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Rigid base ઉપર column spindle head,adjustable work table support કરે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Base machine anchor કરે,permitted large work support કરે.

Column main upright reference,support આપે.

Head motor,belt/gear speed transmission રાખે.

Spindle/quill drill holder રાખે,axial travel આપે.

Table drill vice,clamps,fixture,permitted backing support કરે.

Feed controls,depth stop approach,required depth નિયંત્રિત કરે.

Guarding,approved coolant/chip management,stop controls hazards સંભાળે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Drawingથી hole location,size,tolerance ઓળખો.

Applicable હોય ત્યાં breakthrough clearance સાથે work clamp/locate કરો.

Approved drill/holder mount કરીને suitable speed/feed પસંદ કરો.

Motor transmission spindle,drill ફેરવે.

Axial feed lipsને materialમાં આગળ ધપાવે;flutes chip space આપે.

Approved depth/exit plan blind-hole bottom કે breakthrough control કરે.

Measuring,deburring,chips clearing પહેલાં safely stop કરો,approved tools લો.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Rotating tool પાસે gloves નહિ;job હાથથી પકડવો કે rotating drillનો swarf દૂર કરવો નહિ.

h.en: 4.1.3 Common drill types and sample specifications

body.en:
Definition / principle

Choose capacity and reach, not just a nominal motor rating.

Understand why

Bench/sensitive drills suit small work; pillar drills handle wider general work within capacity.

Radial drills reach different locations on large work; gang drills arrange successive stations; multispindle drills make several holes together.

Illustrative pillar specification:steel drilling capacity25mm, spindle travel150mm, throat250mm, speed100–2500rev/min, motor1.5kW.

Actual capacity depends on material, tool, feed and rigidity. State spindle taper, table travel and spindle-to-table distance too.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

ફક્ત motor rating નહિ,capacity,reach પસંદ કરો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Bench/sensitive drill small work માટે;pillar capacityમાં general work માટે.

Radial large workમાં જુદી locations;gang drill successive stations;multispindle એકસાથે અનેક holes બનાવે.

Illustrative pillar specification:steel capacity25mm,spindle travel150mm,throat250mm,speed100–2500rev/min,motor1.5kW.

Actual capacity material,tool,feed,rigidity પર આધારિત;spindle taper,table travel,spindle-to-table distance પણ લખો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

The head travels along a radial arm so the tool can reach a large stationary workpiece.

Construction:part and purpose

A heavy base supports the work or a box table and column.

The column carries an arm that can swing about it.

Arm elevation adjusts the working height within stated limits.

A travelling head positions the spindle along the arm.

Spindle/quill, tool taper and transmission provide drilling rotation and axial feed.

Approved arm, column and head locks secure positions before cutting.

Controls, guards and workholding manage the larger reach and cutting loads.

Working:flow and reason

Locate/clamp the heavy work on a suitable base/table arrangement.

Within the authorised procedure, position arm height and swing for reach.

Travel the head along the arm to align spindle with the hole location.

Apply the specified locks and verify tool/work clearance.

The spindle rotates the drill while quill feed supplies axial penetration.

Use the planned hole operation and approved chip/coolant arrangement.

Stop safely before relocating the head or inspecting the hole.

Common mistake / conditions

Illustrative data:arm reach1000mm, steel capacity40mm, spindle travel250mm; not an inspected machine specification.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Head radial arm પર ચાલે જેથી tool large stationary workpiece સુધી પહોંચે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Heavy base work/box table,column support કરે.

Column તેની આસપાસ swing થતો arm રાખે.

Arm elevation stated limitsમાં working height બદલે.

Travelling head spindleને arm પર position કરે.

Spindle/quill,tool taper,transmission rotation,axial feed આપે.

Approved arm,column,head locks cutting પહેલાં position secure કરે.

Controls,guards,workholding larger reach,cutting loads સંભાળે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Heavy workને suitable base/table પર locate/clamp કરો.

Authorised procedureમાં arm height,swing position કરો.

Headને arm પર ચલાવી spindle,hole location align કરો.

Specified locks લગાવી tool/work clearance verify કરો.

Spindle drill ફેરવે;quill feed axial penetration આપે.

Planned hole operation,approved chip/coolant arrangement લો.

Head relocate કે hole inspect કરતાં પહેલાં safely stop કરો.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Illustrative data:arm reach1000mm,steel capacity40mm,spindle travel250mm;inspected machine specification નહિ.

h.en: 4.1.5 Twist-drill geometry:each feature has a job

body.en:
Definition / principle

A twist drill combines cutting lips, flutes, web, margins and a point.

Understand why

Two principal lips remove material; the chisel edge at the web centre has poor cutting action and contributes substantial thrust.

Flutes carry chips and admit fluid; the web provides core strength and changes toward the shank.

Margins help guide the drill; body clearance limits rubbing behind them.

Point angle is between the lips in the appropriate axial view; 118degrees is common for general-purpose drills, not compulsory for every material.

Helix angle affects chip flow and rake; lip relief allows cutting without flank rubbing. Unequal lips can oversize/wander a hole.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Twist drillમાં cutting lips,flutes,web,margins,point હોય.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

બે main lips material દૂર કરે;web centreની chisel edgeનું cutting નબળું,thrustમાં મોટો ફાળો હોય.

Flutes chips લઈ જાય,fluid લાવે;web core strength આપે,shank તરફ બદલાય.

Margins drill guide કરે;body clearance પાછળ rubbing ઘટાડે.

Point angle યોગ્ય axial viewમાં lips વચ્ચેનો angle;118degrees general-purposeમાં common,દરેક material માટે compulsory નહિ.

Helix chip flow,rakeને અસર કરે;lip relief flank rubbing અટકાવે.Unequal lipsથી hole oversize/wander થાય.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Name the feature and the amount/purpose of removal.

Understand why

Drilling creates a hole; centre/spot drilling prepares a guided start where specified.

Reaming removes a small allowance for size/finish; boring enlarges/trues an existing hole.

Counterboring makes a cylindrical recess with a flat shoulder; countersinking makes a conical recess.

Spot facing makes a local flat seat; appropriate tapping equipment can produce internal threads.

A blind hole needs bottom-depth planning; through-hole time must include the drill point exiting where full diameter is required.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Feature તથા removalનું amount/purpose જણાવો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Drilling hole બનાવે;specified હોય ત્યાં centre/spot drilling guided start આપે.

Reaming નાના allowanceથી size/finish સુધારે;boring existing hole enlarge/true કરે.

Counterboring flat shoulderવાળો cylindrical recess;countersinking conical recess બનાવે.

Spot facing local flat seat બનાવે;appropriate tapping equipment internal threads બનાવે.

Blind holeમાં bottom-depth planning;full diameter જોઈએ ત્યાં through-hole timeમાં drill-point exit લેવું પડે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A reamer is a multi-edge finishing tool for a previously formed hole.

Understand why

Leave the recommended allowance for size/material/tool; too little may rub, too much can overload.

Hand and machine reamers differ in lead, shank and intended use; straight/helical flute choices depend on duty.

Reaming follows the existing hole strongly; it is not the best process for correcting a badly misplaced axis.

Use maker-recommended speed/feed, alignment and fluid rather than copying drilling values uncritically.

Inspect with suitable gauges after safe stopping; reamer nominal size alone does not prove the finished hole tolerance.

Can reaming reliably relocate a badly off-centre hole?

Not reliably; consider an appropriate boring/setup correction instead.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Reamer previously formed hole માટે multi-edge finishing tool છે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Size/material/tool મુજબ recommended allowance રાખો;ઓછું હોય તો rubbing,વધારે તો overload.

Hand,machine reamerમાં lead,shank,use જુદાં;straight/helical flute duty મુજબ.

Reaming existing holeને અનુસરે;ખૂબ ખોટી axis સુધારવા best process નહિ.

Maker-recommended speed/feed,alignment,fluid લો;drilling values અંધપણે copy નહિ.

Safe stop પછી suitable gauges લો;reamer nominal sizeથી final tolerance સાબિત નહિ.

Reamingથી ખૂબ Off-centre Hole Relocate થાય?

Reliable રીતે નહિ;appropriate boring/setup correction વિચારો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Prevent torque-driven work rotation and keep the tool axis repeatable.

Understand why

A drill vice handles suitable small work; clamps, T-bolts, V-blocks and fixtures handle other shapes.

Drill jigs guide tools with suitable bushes and locate work for repeatability; fixtures mainly hold/locate without necessarily guiding the drill.

Straight-shank drills commonly use suitable chucks; Morse-taper tools use matched spindle sockets/sleeves.

Keep interfaces clean and properly seated; remove keys and use only approved ejection methods under safe conditions.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Torqueથી work rotation અટકાવો,tool axis repeatable રાખો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Drill vice suitable small work;clamps,T-bolts,V-blocks,fixtures અન્ય shapes માટે.

Drill jig suitable bushesથી tool guide,work locate કરે;fixture મુખ્યત્વે hold/locate કરે,drill guide કરવું જરૂરી નહિ.

Straight-shank drill suitable chuckમાં;Morse-taper tools matched sockets/sleevesમાં.

Interfaces clean,seated રાખો;keys દૂર કરો,safe conditionsમાં approved ejection methods જ લો.

body.en:
Given and model

Drill D20mm through plate thickness30mm, Vc25m/min, f.2mm/rev; select N400; allow point travel6mm plus approach2mm.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Ncalculated=1000×25/(pi×20)=397.887rev/min
  2. Feed rate=.2×400=80mm/min
  3. Full-engagement MRR=(pi×20²/4)×80=25132.741mm³/min
  4. Total travel=30+6+2=38mm; time=38/80=.475min=28.5s

Common mistake / conditions

For118degree point, the geometric point lengthD/[2tan(59degrees)]≈.30043D; 6mm is the stated rounded allowance. Full-engagement MRR does not apply unchanged during entry/exit.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

D20mm drill,plate30mm,Vc25m/min,f.2mm/rev;N400 લો;point travel6mm,approach2mm.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Ncalculated=1000×25/(pi×20)=397.887rev/min
  2. Feed rate=.2×400=80mm/min
  3. Full-engagement MRR=(pi×20²/4)×80=25132.741mm³/min
  4. Total travel=30+6+2=38mm;time=38/80=.475min=28.5s

Common Mistake / શરતો

118degree point માટે point length D/[2tan(59degrees)]≈.30043D;6mm stated rounded allowance છે.Entry/exitમાં full-engagement MRR same નથી.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A rotating horizontal boring spindle machines an existing hole while table/column motions establish position.

Construction:part and purpose

A rigid bed supports the main machine units and reference ways.

A column carries the spindle head and vertical positioning arrangement.

The boring spindle/bar holds a correctly secured cutting tool.

A work table locates/clamps the housing or block.

Table travel and permitted rotary positions provide alignment/access.

Outboard support, where fitted, limits long-bar deflection.

Drives, readouts, lubrication and guarding support controlled cutting.

Working:flow and reason

Locate a datum and rigidly secure the work around an existing hole.

Align spindle position to the required bore axis.

Set the suitable boring tool within machine/bar capacity.

The spindle rotates the tool to supply cutting velocity.

A controlled axial feed passes the edge through the hole.

Additional permitted facing, drilling or milling attachments can serve housing features.

Stop safely and gauge bore size, alignment and finish with suitable methods.

Common mistake / conditions

Long overhang increases chatter; boring can improve coaxial features only within the accuracy of setup, machine and measurement.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Rotating horizontal boring spindle existing hole machine કરે;table/column motions position આપે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Rigid bed main units,reference ways support કરે.

Column spindle head,vertical positioning રાખે.

Boring spindle/bar correctly secured tool પકડે.

Work table housing/block locate/clamp કરે.

Table travel,permitted rotary positions alignment/access આપે.

Fitted outboard support long-bar deflection ઘટાડે.

Drives,readouts,lubrication,guarding controlled cuttingમાં મદદ કરે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Existing holeવાળું work datumથી rigidly secure કરો.

Spindleને required bore axis પર align કરો.

Machine/bar capacityમાં suitable boring tool set કરો.

Spindle tool ફેરવી cutting velocity આપે.

Controlled axial feed edgeને holeમાં પસાર કરે.

Permitted facing,drilling,milling attachments housing features બનાવી શકે.

Safely stop કરીને suitable methodથી bore size,alignment,finish માપો.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Long overhang chatter વધારે;coaxial accuracy setup,machine,measurement સુધી જ મળે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Use boring when the existing hole needs controlled diameter or axis relationship.

Understand why

Applications include bearing housings, gearbox bores and aligned machine-body holes.

Drilling forms the initial hole; boring is single-point/adjustable enlargement in the typical case; reaming is multi-edge finishing.

Boring-bar deflection, thermal changes and tool wear affect final size; take measuring-system uncertainty into account.

An accurate drawing answer identifies which item rotates and which feeds instead of assuming every boring machine has identical kinematics.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Existing holeનું diameter કે axis relation control કરવું હોય ત્યારે boring લો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Bearing housings,gearbox bores,aligned machine-body holesમાં ઉપયોગ થાય.

Drilling initial hole બનાવે;typical boring single-point/adjustable enlargement;reaming multi-edge finishing છે.

Bar deflection,thermal change,wear final size બદલે;measurement uncertainty ધ્યાનમાં લો.

Drawing answerમાં શું rotate,શું feed કરે તે બતાવો;દરેક boring machineની kinematics same ન માનો.

title.en: 4.2 Read the hole section before calculating

body.en:
Definition / principle

A bolt-seat drawing determines recess shape; the names are not synonyms.

Understand why

Counterboring forms an enlarged cylindrical recess with a shoulder, for suitable socket-head fasteners or seats.

Countersinking makes a conical entrance; match the specified included angle rather than assuming every screw uses the same cone.

Spot facing removes just enough local material to provide a flat bearing seat around a hole.

Pilot guidance, tool alignment, depth control and clamping affect concentricity and seat quality.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Bolt-seat drawing recess shape નક્કી કરે;આ નામો synonyms નથી.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Counterboring enlarged cylindrical recess,shoulder આપે,suitable socket-head fastener/seat માટે.

Countersinking conical entrance આપે;દરેક screw માટે same cone ન માની specified included angle લો.

Spot facing hole આસપાસ flat bearing seat માટે જરૂરી local material દૂર કરે.

Pilot guidance,tool alignment,depth control,clamping concentricity,seat qualityને અસર કરે.

h.en: 4.2.2 Blind-hole depth:full diameter vs point tip
h.gu: 4.2.2 Blind-hole Depth:Full Diameter સામે Point Tip

body.en:
Given and model

D10mm,118degree point; required full-diameter depth20mm, f.1mm/rev, N500, approach1mm.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Point length=10/[2tan(59degrees)]=3.0043mm
  2. Tip travel from surface≈20+3.0043=23.0043mm
  3. Total fed travel=23.0043+1=24.0043mm
  4. Time=24.0043/(.1×500)=.480086min

Common mistake / conditions

If the drawing instead specifies tip depth, the travel is different. Check remaining wall thickness and the bottom definition before machining.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

D10mm,118degree point;required full-diameter depth20mm,f.1mm/rev,N500,approach1mm.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Point length=10/[2tan(59degrees)]=3.0043mm
  2. Tip travel from surface≈20+3.0043=23.0043mm
  3. Total fed travel=23.0043+1=24.0043mm
  4. Time=24.0043/(.1×500)=.480086min

Common Mistake / શરતો

Drawing tip depth બતાવે તો travel જુદી થાય.Machining પહેલાં remaining wall thickness,bottom definition જુઓ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A report explains how the hole requirement was met; it is not a copied list of operations.

Understand why

Include drawing, datum, hole coordinates, size, tolerance and through/blind definition.

List marking/punching or guided-location arrangements as appropriate and approved; precision holes may need different locating methods.

Explain holding, tools, parameter source, RPM/feed/time and the order of drilling/finishing/deburring.

Attach actual inspection evidence only if obtained; report any deviation rather than inventing perfect readings.

Are hole tip depth and full-diameter depth identical?

No. A pointed drill adds a conical bottom/point length.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Report hole requirement કેવી રીતે પૂરી થઈ તે સમજાવે;copied operations list નહિ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Drawing,datum,coordinates,size,tolerance,through/blind definition લો.

Appropriate approved marking/punching/guided-location લખો;precision holesમાં locating method જુદું હોઈ શકે.

Holding,tools,parameter source,RPM/feed/time,drilling/finishing/deburring order સમજાવો.

ખરેખર obtained inspection evidence જ લો;perfect readings invent કર્યા વગર deviation લખો.

Hole Tip Depth,Full-diameter Depth Same?

ના.Pointed drillમાં conical bottom/point length વધે.
